change.item: the batch page's item detail shows a Table section for an item whose card states format csv or xlsx with family table and whose original is kept (its own sourceId, or for one sheet of a kept workbook the workbook's). The file name never decides.
change.press: Read as a table: TableSelectionFields (reused; for a workbook the sheet is filled when the card states one sheet, and the card's sheets are offered as a list), then tableFromOriginal with a new request key and the workspace revision from readSourceCase
change.answers: 201 opens the table page; 202 shows TP1's queued and running words and resends the same request every 2 s until the job ends, then opens the page; a refusal shows the server's words and code on the item (TableRefusal) and the next press sends a new request key; a lost answer for the same choice resends the same key
change.already_a_table: GET .../sources/{sourceId}/profile answers manual-tabular/1 once the source is a table: the section then says so and links Open the table; before that the read refuses and the press is shown
change.shared_hook: table/useFollowTable.ts holds TP1's follow loop, job words and the opening of the table page; the import dialog (useRetainTable) and the batch item both use it
change.seams: retain.ts: tableFormat(file) and formatSelection(format, sheet, rows) split out of tableSelection (same result for the dialog); TableImportFields.tsx: TableSelectionFields takes the format and optional stated sheets instead of the File
change.n01_routing: unchanged: a dropped CSV or XLSX still opens the table import
